wineGlass.evidenceText: The exact-Hanoi public menu labels WINE BY THE GLASS as 150 ml | 750 ml. In the RED section it lists Santa Cristina 440, Domaine des Hautes Troglodytes Saumur-Champigny 400, and Gerard Bertrand '6eme Sens' Pays d’OC 360. The menu states all prices are quoted in thousand VND and are subject to a 5% service charge and applicable VAT.
wineGlass.referencePeriod: Public menu PDF published April 2026; accessed 2026-08-01
wineGlass.searchQuery: Hanoi Vietnam wine menu red wine glass 125 ml 150 ml current public
wineGlass.reason: One exact-Hanoi public menu supplies three standard dry-red wines, each explicitly priced for the same 150 ml glass. Raw menu amounts are retained in the source's thousand-VND denomination; no arithmetic or tax adjustment was made.
